title: Week in Orbit
summary: This week, the space and defense sectors are buzzing with strategic partnerships and financial maneuvers. From Australia’s dual-use infrastructure to SpaceX's IPO, the landscape is shifting, albeit with a few hiccups along the way.

themes.title: Australia's Strategic Space Moves
themes.body: Australia is ramping up its dual-use space infrastructure, leveraging AUKUS to bolster strategic resilience. This development signals a growing recognition of the importance of space capabilities in national security.

themes.title: SpaceX's Financial Unveiling
themes.body: SpaceX's recent IPO filing sheds light on its ambitious Starlink Mobile, positioning it as a potential competitor in the wireless market. Investors are keenly watching how this could reshape telecommunications.

themes.title: Rocket Lab's Expanding Footprint
themes.body: Rocket Lab continues to make headlines, launching its ninth Synspective satellite and securing a GEO satellite production contract from the U.S. Space Force. This momentum underscores the company’s growing role in the satellite ecosystem.

themes.title: Defense-Tech IPO Buzz
themes.body: The defense-tech sector is showing signs of life with the potential opening of the IPO window, as evidenced by Palantir's $480M extension on the TITAN program. This could signal a shift in investment focus towards defense capabilities amid rising geopolitical tensions.
